notes.title: Next Update
notes.notes:
Greetings
We are bringing Mutagen Extinction to a new and improved graphics engine, which greatly improves game performance as well as overall graphics quality.
We have improved the map of the game, as well as all the elements that compose it, giving more realism to the image and immersion.
We have added a tutorial for new players, which teaches the basics of the game.
We have added various quests offering different difficulties which can be of great help to advance in the game.

Soon we will have this update online
